cases.sentence: Видение славы Господней На тридцатом году моей жизни, когда я был среди пленников у реки ___.
cases.explain: The genitive follows 'у' (by) when indicating location near a place.

cases.sentence: Я смотрел и видел смерч, который надвигался с ___.
cases.translation: A stormy wind came out of the north
cases.explain: The genitive follows 'с' (from) when indicating the direction from which something comes.

cases.sentence: Посреди огня было нечто подобное сияющему ___.
cases.explain: The dative after 'подобному' means 'similar to' indicating what it resembles.

cases.sentence: В огне были подобия четырех живых ___.
cases.translation: the likeness of four living creatures
cases.explain: The genitive is used after the numeral 'четырех' (four) with plural nouns.

cases.sentence: Ноги у них были прямыми, а ступни ног, как у теленка, и сверкали, как отполированная ___.
cases.explain: The nominative is used in similes with 'как' (like) when the thing being compared to is the predicate.

cases.sentence: Я смотрел на живых существ и видел на земле колеса возле них, по одному на каждого из ___.
cases.explain: The genitive is used after 'каждого из' (each of) when referring to a set.

cases.sentence: Их ободья высоки и страшны. Ободья у всех четырех были кругом полны ___.
cases.translation: the rims were full of eyes
cases.explain: The genitive is used after 'полны' (full of) to indicate what fills something.

cases.sentence: Над сводом, который был над их головами, было нечто подобное престолу из ___.
cases.translation: the likeness of a throne as the appearance of a sapphire stone
cases.explain: The genitive follows 'из' (from/of) when indicating what something is made of.

reading.ru: На тридцатом году моей жизни, в пятый день четвертого месяца, когда я был среди пленников у реки Кевар, небеса раскрылись, и было мне видение от Бога.
reading.question: When did Ezekiel receive his vision?
options: In the thirtieth year of his life, on the fifth day of the fourth month
In the fortieth year of his life, on the first day of the year
At midnight on the Sabbath day
reading.correct: In the thirtieth year of his life, on the fifth day of the fourth month
reading.explain: The text states the vision came when he was thirty years old, on the fifth day of the fourth month.

reading.ru: Я смотрел и видел смерч, который надвигался севером, огромное облако со сверкающими молниями, окруженное сиянием.
reading.question: What did the storm from the north look like?
options: A great cloud with flashing lightning, surrounded by brightness
A massive ocean with waves of fire
A dark tunnel descending from heaven
A chariot drawn by white horses
reading.correct: A great cloud with flashing lightning, surrounded by brightness
reading.explain: The text describes a stormy wind from the north as a great cloud with flashing lightning surrounded by brightness.

reading.ru: Обличием они походили на людей, но у каждого из них было по четыре лица и четыре крыла.
reading.question: How many faces and wings did each creature have?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states each creature had four faces and four wings.

reading.ru: Облик живых существ был подобен пламенеющим углем, подобен факелам.
reading.question: What did the living creatures' appearance resemble?
options: Burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches
The form of humans made of stone
Trees in a forest during autumn
Stars shining in the night sky
reading.correct: Burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches
reading.explain: The text says their appearance was like burning coals of fire and like torches.

reading.ru: Они выглядели так, словно колесо находилось в колесе.
reading.question: How were the wheels structured?
options: As if a wheel was within a wheel
Like four separate wheels arranged in a square
Like a spiral or tornado shape
reading.correct: As if a wheel was within a wheel
reading.explain: The text describes the wheels as appearing as if one wheel was within another wheel.

reading.ru: Над сводом, который был над их головами, было нечто подобное престолу из сапфира, а над подобием престола сверху восседал некто, похожий на человека.
reading.question: What did Ezekiel see above the expanse?
options: A throne of sapphire with a figure like a man sitting above it
reading.correct: A throne of sapphire with a figure like a man sitting above it
reading.explain: The text states that above the expanse was a throne like sapphire, and above it sat one like the Son of Man.
